name: Thermal
means: Heat as image: black-body colour ramp from blue to white, no texture at all, glowing bodies against a cold ground.
prose: a thermal image - a blue-to-white heat colour ramp, no surface texture, warm bodies glowing against a cold ground
works_for: video - a global false-colour mapping, very stable
note: Extremely distinctive and unlikely to be confused with anything. The risk is the opposite of the usual one - it may be SO strong that it erases the character and the setting together. | Authored in the second wave, after the first 64 were rendered and measured. status=untested because nothing here has been rendered yet - the first wave shipped 46 cards marked ready without a single render and 27 of 64 turned out to be routed to the wrong engine.
verdict: Recoloured her coat and scarf into a rainbow gradient and left the street a normal photograph. It painted the ramp onto an object instead of remapping the image. A STYLE LoRA WAS TRIED AND FAILED, and it failed in both directions: the ramp-on-the-garment survived modern_anime at 1.0 and 1.5 and storybook at 1.0 completely unchanged, while illustration at 1.0 deleted the ramp altogether and returned an ordinary grey-coat photograph and at 1.5 returned a painted illustration with no thermal anything. False colour is a GLOBAL REMAP of every pixel, and no style LoRA on this box does global remapping. This belongs in studio/looks/ as an ffmpeg grade, which is what the card's own note already argued.
verified_by: Looked at, against the no-style control at the same seed with the same subject, on both engines. studio/_tools/style_examples.py --all-engines
